identity.normalization: Packet list already ID-2 normalized (Aqua (Water, Eau) is one entry); positions below are normalized one-based positions; 78 entries; no split synonym entries found.

cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: no prominent strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate @2 (mild anionic) with prominent amphoteric Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine @3 and nonionic glucoside Decyl Glucoside @10 as co-surfactants. Counter-signal: a very broad anionic system (Potassium Cocoyl Glycinate @4, Disodium Cocoyl Glutamate @5, Potassium Cocoate @6, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate @7, Sodium Methyl Isethionate @8, Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate @36, Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate @42, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate @44, Sodium Laurate @57) including two soaps whose C3 class is not named (assigned mild anionic by carboxylate chemistry, C3 unlisted-surfactant rule). Read as a strong anionic, Potassium Cocoate @6 would make the chassis buffered -> moderate; hence moderate confidence, neighbor moderate (N-ALT). Formula not known complete (ID-1) and the list order is evidently not descending (cleansing surfactants at 36-44 after extracts and oils).

conditioningLevel.rationale: high by C2: early (prominent, E3) silicone Amodimethicone @34 and Divinyldimethicone/Dimethicone Copolymer @35, cationic polymers Polyquaternium-10 @30, Polyquaternium-11 @31, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @32, pearlizing route Glycol Distearate @37, and a deliberate humectant route (Sodium Hyaluronate @13, Panthenol @14, Glycerin @48); further routes: payload oils @24-26, protein @28, Quaternium-95 @52. Counter-signal: all conditioning entries sit after a long extract block in a list that is not in descending order, and the formula is not known complete (ID-1), so the real levels may be trace; moderate confidence, neighbor moderate.

weightPotential.rationale: high (low confidence, needs_research): multiple converging, plausibly persistent deposition families (silicone @34/@35 incl. amodimethicone, three cationic polymers @30-32, cationic conditioner @52, material payload lipids @24-26, protein film @28) face a weak reset (C6 low chassis); W-RICH holds (material oils converging with silicone and cationic polymers) with limited reset. Confidence low because the formula is not known complete (ID-1, 6.6 unknowns) and the list order is evidently unreliable, so the real deposition load may be lower; neighbor moderate.

weightPotential.depositionLoadRationale: Two silicones (incl. amodimethicone), three cationic polymers, a quat, three oils and a protein converge; all prominent by order, although the order is unreliable.
weightPotential.persistenceRationale: Amino-silicone plus high-MW dimethicone copolymer and three cationic polymers are persistent rinse-off depositing systems.
weightPotential.resetCapacityRationale: C6 low chassis of mild anionics, sultaine and glucoside; no strong anionic.
weightPotential.counterevidence: List order is evidently not descending (oils after eight extracts, surfactants at 36-57, preservatives before Parfum), so the oils, polymers and silicones may all be trace-level; formula not known complete.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: W-RICH (material oils @24-26 converging with silicone @34/35 and cationic polymers @30-32) with resetCapacity weak meets the high anchor's rich route; the convergence route (silicone + cationic polymer + material lipid) also holds.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate would require reset to offset the converging persistent systems or the deposition to be light; the chassis is mild (weak reset) and no ordering evidence available inside the method shows the systems to be trace, but the unreliable order and incompleteness keep moderate realistic.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Formula not known complete (ID-1; 6.6 unknowns: low-confidence provisional band) and an evidently non-descending list order.

focusPrimary.rationale: Provisional, claim-dependent (3.1): claims are hidden, so no claim candidate exists and focus stays general. Formula routes a claim could later use: repair (Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate @11, protein @28, amodimethicone @34, cationic polymers) and moisture (Sodium Hyaluronate @13, Panthenol @14, Glycerin @48, oils @24-26); provisional care-direction verdict dual_supported.

careDirection.limitation: List order unreliable; levels unknown; not known complete.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: No claims visible in the blind pass.

focusSecondary.rationale: Provisional: empty default; no claims visible (Section 8).

usageRole.rationale: Provisional default regular (Section 9); triggers need claims. cleansingStrength is not strong, so frequency wording could fire frequent; alternating and treatment are not reachable from this formula (not strong; dandruffSupport not supported).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Provisional: positioning (SC1) is claim-dependent and hidden. Formula half (CSA) is met: prominent comfort route Panthenol @14; prominent humectant routes Sodium Hyaluronate @13, Glycerin @48 and payload oils @24-26. Counter-signals not prominent: Menthol @76, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil @73 after Parfum. Low confidence also because the formula is not known complete (ID-1).

dandruffSupport.rationale: unknown by Section 11 and ID-1: no Piroctone Olamine, Climbazole, Selenium Sulfide or Selenium Disulfide in the visible list, but the formula is not known complete (tier-4 source), so absence cannot be confirmed.
